about_the_game:
If you're a huge fan of Fischer's Fishing Journey and wish to lend your support to the Cutefish team, this Supporter Pack is a wonderful way to do it. We're thrilled to have you as a special companion on Fischer's adventure! Every bit of your support means the world to us!

This DLC includes:

1、A cute Cat Sun Umbrella

2、A Decorative Fish Basket

3、A Decorative Frame for your Fish Tank

Please note: This DLC contains cosmetic and support content only, and does not affect actual gameplay or progress.
